title: index-status-workflow: Wire or remove index_status, index_workflow, and pending_actions gate
description: Task P2-15. Three dead-code sub-issues. (1) index_status and index_workflow write APIs exist in vb_storage/src/indexes.rs:15-35 but no production caller. (2) UnsupportedRecoveryState::pending_actions is tracked in summary.rs:381 but never set (per the comment) and never read (the runtime gate at runtime/recovery.rs:73-82 omits it). seed.pending_actions: Vec<RecoveredPendingAction> is built and dropped. (3) RunSnapshot write API exists in vb_storage/src/snapshots.rs:33-45 but no production caller. Dead code in a high-assurance system is a hazard: the code says one thing, the system does another. Master §30 and §29 require these APIs; if they're orphaned, the answer is to wire them or remove them. This bead: 3 sub-fixes (chose per path): (15.1) wire index_status/index_workflow in the runtime to write when status changes, OR remove the keyspaces and reader methods; (15.2) set pending_actions: true when there are pending actions that cannot be resumed, OR remove the field; (15.3) wire RunSnapshot in the runtime to write snapshots (P2-18), OR remove the type. The deliverable is the decision (wired in or removed) for each of the 3. Must be resolved before P0-5 lands (P0-5 depends on P2-15).

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT have orphaned write APIs in production code; every write API must be called by the runtime OR be removed
THE SYSTEM SHALL resolve the 3 dead-code sub-issues (index_status/index_workflow, pending_actions gate, RunSnapshot) by either wiring or removing

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a run's status changes (e.g., from Running to Failed)
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL write to the index_status keyspace with the new status and run_id (if wired) OR not have the keyspace at all (if removed)

event_driven.trigger: WHEN recovery detects a non-resumable pending action
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL set UnsupportedRecoveryState::pending_actions = true (if wired) OR not have the field (if removed)

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a run completes a snapshot_interval_steps (P2-18)
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL write a RunSnapshot to the journal (if wired) OR not have the type (if removed)

unwanted.condition: IF an API exists in code but is never called
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT silently keep it; the deliverable is to wire it OR remove it
unwanted.because: Master §30 and §29 require these APIs; orphan code is a documentation lie

preconditions: Decision is documented in the bead's evidence: WIRED or REMOVED for each of the 3 sub-issues
postconditions: Each of the 3 APIs is either (a) called by production code, OR (b) removed from the codebase with no callers and no reader methods
No API is left in a half-wired state (some callers, some not)
invariants: Public API surface matches production code paths; no orphans

happy: index_status_wired_or_removed_test: either test_index_status_is_written_on_status_change, or test_index_status_does_not_exist (depending on the decision)
run_snapshot_wired_or_removed_test: either test_run_snapshot_is_written_after_n_steps (depends on P2-18), or test_run_snapshot_type_does_not_exist
error: grep_test_no_orphaned_write_apis: a grep-based test asserts that every `pub fn put_*` in vb_storage is called by some production module
decision_must_be_documented: if neither WIRED nor REMOVED is chosen for a sub-issue, the bead fails the gate (binary decision required)
removal_breaks_callers_test: if REMOVED is chosen, the grep test for the removed API's caller returns 0 callers; if WIRED, returns ≥1 caller
edge: evidence_documents_the_decision: a markdown file in .evidence/p2-15-decision.md records WIRED or REMOVED for each of the 3 sub-issues with rationale

files: crates/vb_storage/src/indexes.rs:15-35 (index_status, index_workflow write APIs; no callers)
crates/vb_storage/src/summary.rs:381 (UnsupportedRecoveryState::pending_actions; tracked but never set per the comment)
crates/vb_runtime/src/runtime/mod.rs (where the index writers would be called from)
patterns: Pattern: existing index reader methods (if removed, the readers go too)
Pattern: P2-18 will wire RunSnapshot via Runtime; this bead decides the wire path or removal
questions: Which decision is correct for each of the 3 sub-issues? The answer is a deliverable, not a foregone conclusion. The implementer must review the master doc, the test coverage, and the call sites, then choose.

security_failures.failure: An orphan API is enabled by a future change and silently writes to an unused keyspace, growing the journal unbounded
security_failures.prevention: Either wire it (so growth is bounded) or remove it (so the keyspace doesn't exist)

usability_failures.failure: Operator reads the master doc, sees index_status is a thing, queries it, gets stale data because nothing writes to it
usability_failures.prevention: If the doc says it exists, it must be wired
usability_failures.test_for_it: master_doc_and_implementation_agree (assert every API in §29/§30 is either wired or removed)

data_integrity_failures.failure: A reader method returns empty data because nothing writes, leading the operator to conclude the index is broken
data_integrity_failures.prevention: Either wire the writer or remove the reader

integration_failures.failure: P0-5 (Runtime::recover) lands and tries to use RecoveredRunAdmission, but the pending_actions field has been removed
integration_failures.prevention: Coordinate: this bead decides; P0-5 follows. If removal is chosen, P0-5 must not reference the removed field

phase_0: Read crates/vb_storage/src/indexes.rs:15-35 to find the API signatures
Read crates/vb_storage/src/snapshots.rs:33-45 to find the RunSnapshot API
Read crates/vb_storage/src/summary.rs:381 to confirm the pending_actions field is tracked but never set
Read crates/vb_runtime/src/recovery.rs:73-82 to confirm the gate omits pending_actions
Grep for callers of put_index_status, put_index_workflow, put_snapshot, RecoveredRunAdmission::pending_actions
phase_2: For each of the 3 sub-issues: WIRE or REMOVE

If WIRE: add the call sites in the runtime (e.g., Runtime::submit_direct writes to index_status; Runtime::recover sets pending_actions; Shard::tick writes a RunSnapshot every N steps — depends on P2-18)
If REMOVE: delete the API, the keyspace, and any reader methods; update master §29/§30 to remove the references
phase_3: Coordinate with P0-5 and P2-18: if removal is chosen, those beads must not reference the removed APIs
phase_4: Run `moon run :test -p vb_storage -p vb_runtime` and verify all new tests pass
Manual: grep test must pass; decision document must be committed

similar_implementations: No prior precedent; this bead sets the policy

key_sections_to_understand: The put_index_status and put_index_workflow function signatures

apis_that_exist: UnsupportedRecoveryState { pending_actions: bool, action_payloads: bool, ... } in vb_storage::summary
apis_that_do_not_exist: No production callers for any of the 3; this bead creates the callers or removes the APIs
no_placeholder_values: Do NOT leave the APIs in a half-wired state; the decision is binary
